row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (priced per AI-translated word, unlimited seats)
row.evidence: Transifex's single plan lists 'SSO & 2FA included' and its SAML help article supports one IdP set up through support; neither the help centre nor the API reference documents SCIM.
row.notes: No SCIM; status unchanged. Pricing changed since June: the Starter $139 / Growth $369 / Advanced $749 / PRO $1549 / Enterprise+ tiers are gone. Transifex (now branded XTM Transifex) sells one Contact Sales plan priced on AI-translated words with unlimited collaborators, and lists SSO as included; the SAML help article still says Enterprise Plus only. SSO is SAML with a single IdP (Okta officially), configured by Transifex support, no JIT. Users are managed by invitation and team memberships; the REST API (bearer token) exposes team memberships and roles but no org-level user create/remove.

plans.name: AI-First Plan (single plan)
plans.price_text: Contact Sales; priced on AI-translated word volume, unlimited collaborators

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Transifex help centre index (llms.txt), the developer API reference index (llms.txt) or the pricing page. SAML SSO is configured through Transifex support and needs the user to already exist with the same email.

auth.notes: Token carries the rights of the user who generated it; no scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Get the details of a user
Create a team membership (role: coordinator, reviewer or translator per language)

rate_limits.text: 500 requests/min or 30,000 requests per 5 minutes per IP; 429 when throttled.

limitations.text: No documented endpoint to list organization users, invite, deactivate or remove a user from the organization; membership is managed per team/language.

user_api.notes: Organization activity report downloads exist in the API index but are reports, not an audit-log API.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SWA only. Transifex's help says Okta is its only officially supported SAML IdP, set up as a custom SAML app with support.

fallbacks.notes: SSO users must already have a Transifex account with the same email; no automatic account creation is documented (recorded false from 'should be the same as the one used in your TX account').
